formulas.absolute_score: sum over criteria of (score / max_score) * weight
formulas.benchmark: highest validated score for the criterion across all suppliers in the run
formulas.gap: score - benchmark (0 for the benchmark leader, otherwise negative)
formulas.relative_pct: score / benchmark * 100; if benchmark == 0 then 0 (no supplier showed evidence, no peer credit)

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.justification: Apex Systems demonstrates an exceptional technical architecture featuring microservices on Azure, Kafka event-driven ingestion, Delta Lake lakehouse, and pre-built enterprise connectors. Scalability is proven through load testing up to 50 million spend lines and 2,000 concurrent users.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] All integrations are bidirectional with retry queues and dead-letter handling....Multi-region disaster recovery with RPO 15 minutes and RTO 2 hours.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.justification: The implementation plan provides a structured 20-week timeline with defined milestones and a peak staffing of 9 FTEs including a named lead architect. Risk management is explicitly planned with weekly reviews and sandbox mock data fallbacks.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Go-live & hypercare...Weeks 19-20...Production go-live...[Page 2] Risk register maintained weekly with owners and mitigations....Key risk: delayed sandbox access - mitigated by mock data contracts from week 1.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.justification: Pricing is clearly itemized into platform, implementation, connectors, security, training, and support totalling $1,340,000. However, recurring cloud hosting costs are excluded and will incur an estimated $6,500 monthly fee, with out-of-scope changes billed at a daily rate.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Total...$1,340,000...[Page 2] Prices exclude Azure consumption, estimated at $6,500/month....Fixed price for listed scope; change requests billed at $1,650/day.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.justification: The security posture is robust with ISO 27001 certification, SOC 2 Type II reporting, customer-managed Azure Key Vault encryption, and immutable audit logs. It also guarantees EU data residency, GDPR compliance, and quarterly penetration tests.
criteria.evidence: [Page 2] ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified (certificate IS-778120) and SOC 2 Type II report (Dec 2025)...AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, customer-managed keys in Azure Key Vault....Immutable audit logs retained for 7 years; GDPR data processing agreement and EU data residency.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.justification: Apex Systems shows strong relevant experience across 11 similar projects and supplies two verifiable enterprise references. However, the standard support model is restricted to CET business hours with a slow 4-hour response time for P1 incidents, requiring an additional add-on for 24x7 support.
criteria.evidence: [Page 2] Support: Business-hours support (08:00-18:00 CET) with 4-hour response for P1 incidents; 24x7 available as an add-on....Delivered 11 procurement analytics platforms since 2019, including for a European grocery chain (9,000 suppliers) and a logistics group.

suppliers.tie_break_note: Ranked above NexaWorks: higher PPI (97.89 vs 95.26).
risks: Exclusion of Azure cloud infrastructure consumption from pricing, adding an ongoing estimated operational expenditure of $6,500 per month.
Project schedule is vulnerable to Northwind sandbox delivery delays if access is not granted by week 3.
Standard SLA provides only business-hours coverage with a 4-hour P1 resolution response unless a 24x7 add-on is procured.
Unbudgeted project change requests are billed at a premium rate of $1,650 per day.
suppliers.overall_summary: Apex Systems submitted a comprehensive and highly competitive proposal featuring strong technical capabilities, solid enterprise certifications (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II), and proven experience with 11 procurement analytics deployments. Key considerations include the exclusion of Azure hosting costs from the fixed fee and standard support limited to business hours.

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.justification: The proposed technical architecture uses proven AWS components, includes native SAP S/4HANA and Coupa connectors, and provides clear scalability parameters up to 20 million spend lines. Technical fit and integration mechanisms are clearly articulated.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Solution: NexaInsight platform on AWS (Redshift, Glue, QuickSight embedded) with standard connectors for SAP S/4HANA and Coupa, and a documented REST API for further integrations. Scales to 20 million spend lines in our current benchmark; larger volumes use Redshift concurrency scaling.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.justification: The implementation plan outlines a structured 22-week timeline across five distinct phases with clear deliverables, an 8 FTE team structure, and concrete risk mitigation protocols.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Implementation approach: agile delivery in four phases with fortnightly demos, a joint steering committee and a documented RACI....Phase 0 - Mobilisation Weeks 1-2 Project charter, RACI, risk register baseline...Phase 4 - Go-live & hypercare Weeks 19-22 Go-live wk 19, hypercare to wk 22...Team: Delivery director (steering), full-time project manager, solution architect, 2 data engineers, BI developer, test lead, change & training lead (8 FTE). Named PM: Samuel Okafor, PMP, 7 similar programmes....[Page 2] Weekly risk and issue review with the steering committee; top risks with owners and dates.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.justification: Pricing is transparently itemized with a fixed implementation fee, transparent licence fees, and milestone-based payments. However, cloud infrastructure is billed at cost based on an estimate, leaving some budget variability.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Item Cost (USD) NexaInsight licence (3 years) $390,000 Implementation (fixed price) $285,000 Connectors SAP + Coupa $60,000 Training & change management $40,000 24x7 support & managed service (3 years) $120,000 Total $895,000 Assumptions: • AWS consumption estimated at $4,200/month and billed at cost. • Fixed price covers the listed scope; 10% contingency held for agreed change requests. • Milestone-based payments: 20% / 30% / 30% / 20%.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.justification: Security controls are solid, covering encryption, SAML 2.0 SSO, RBAC, and GDPR compliance, but SOC 2 Type II is still in progress rather than currently held.
criteria.evidence: [Page 2] • SOC 2 Type I report available; SOC 2 Type II audit window in progress (report due Q3 2026). • Encryption at rest (AWS KMS) and in transit (TLS 1.2+); SSO via SAML 2.0. • Role-based access by business unit; audit logging of all user and admin actions. • GDPR DPA provided; data hosted in AWS eu-west-1.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.justification: NexaWorks provides a 24x7 support model with defined response SLAs, an extended 90-day hypercare period, six relevant implementations, and two named client references in retail.
criteria.evidence: [Page 2] Support: 24x7 support with contractual SLAs: P1 response 30 minutes / restore 4 hours, P2 response 2 hours. Dedicated technical account manager, monthly service reports, 90-day hypercare, and a knowledge-transfer plan so Northwind can self-serve new dashboards. Relevant experience: Six procurement analytics implementations in retail and consumer goods since 2020. References: • Baltic Home Retail - Procurement Director, Maria Lind • GreenLeaf Consumer Goods - Head of Data, Arun Patel

suppliers.tie_break_note: Ranked above Orbit Digital: higher PPI (95.26 vs 58.61).
risks: SOC 2 Type II certification is not yet finalized and will remain pending until Q3 2026.
AWS consumption is billed at cost based on an estimate of $4,200/month, introducing variable infrastructure cost exposure.
Fixed implementation pricing covers strictly listed scope, requiring change requests backed by a 10% contingency for scope adjustments.
suppliers.overall_summary: NexaWorks submits a highly credible, comprehensive proposal featuring standard integrations to ERP systems, a well-defined 22-week implementation methodology, transparent pricing, and strong retail credentials. Key items to manage include tracking completion of their SOC 2 Type II audit and managing variable cloud hosting costs.

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.justification: The platform is hosted on Google Cloud and supports enterprise volumes, but technical details on architecture and connectors are postponed to discovery.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] "OrbitSpend will integrate with Northwind's existing systems as needed; the integration approach and connectors will be finalised during the discovery phase. The platform is hosted on Google Cloud and supports enterprise data volumes."

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.justification: A high-level 24-week timeline is provided, but team sizing is deferred until after discovery and the risk plan lacks concrete detail.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] "Discovery Weeks 1-6 Requirements confirmed...Implementation Weeks 7-20 Platform configured...Go-live Weeks 21-24 Go-live...Team: Account director, project manager and consultants from our retail practice, sized after discovery....Standard project risk management applies."

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.justification: A line-item cost schedule is presented, but key implementation and integration fees are estimates subject to post-discovery adjustments and travel expenses are excluded.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] "Total $965,000 (estimate)...Assumptions:...• Integration and implementation costs are estimates until discovery is complete....• Travel expenses billed separately."

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.justification: The solution covers core baseline security with ISO/IEC 27001 certification, SSO, and encryption, but does not detail auditability or privacy frameworks.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] "• ISO/IEC 27001 certified. Data encrypted at rest and in transit....• SSO supported. Hosted in Google Cloud europe-west regions."

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.justification: The supplier demonstrates deep retail domain experience with relevant references and awards, although the support window is limited to business hours with an 8-hour critical SLA.
criteria.evidence: [Page 2] "Support: Business-hours support with 8-hour response for critical issues; customer success reviews twice a year....Relevant experience: Over 40 procurement analytics deployments since 2011, including 12 retailers with more than $1B annual spend....• Nordic Fashion Group - CPO, Erik Johansson (+46 8 555 0101)"

suppliers.tie_break_note: Ranked above BrightPath Tech: higher PPI (58.61 vs 40.25).
risks: Implementation ($320,000) and integration ($90,000) costs are estimates that could increase substantially after the discovery phase.
Technical integration architecture and connectors are undefined prior to contract signing.
Team sizing is deferred until discovery is complete, introducing resource availability risk.
SLA response time of 8 business hours for critical issues lacks 24/7 emergency support.
suppliers.overall_summary: Orbit Digital demonstrates strong retail domain experience and solid baseline security certifications. However, the proposal carries commercial and delivery uncertainty because integration design, team sizing, and over $400,000 of services pricing are deferred as estimates pending discovery.

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.justification: The solution relies on manual weekly CSV uploads, with SAP integration merely on the roadmap. Furthermore, the architecture is limited to a single-region deployment, and performance testing for Northwind's data volume has not been conducted.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] "Data is loaded from CSV exports that Northwind uploads weekly; an API connector for SAP is on our roadmap."..."The platform runs on a single-region cloud deployment and is suitable for most mid-sized customers."..."Performance testing for Northwind's data volume has not yet been carried out."

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.justification: A high-level 12-week schedule with phases and lean staffing is outlined. However, the proposal explicitly fails to provide any risk management plan.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] "Team: Project manager (part-time) and 2 consultants."..."Risk management:"..."Not provided."

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.justification: Pricing is clearly detailed with a total three-year cost of $370,000. However, essential features such as connectors, custom dashboards, and SSO are excluded and carry additional costs.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] "Total"..."$370,000"..."Assumptions:"..."• CSV exports are prepared and cleaned by Northwind."..."• Additional connectors and custom dashboards are quoted separately."..."SSO is available on the enterprise tier (not included in this price)."

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.justification: While basic encryption is mentioned, BrightPath Tech lacks formal certifications, with ISO 27001 only planned for 2027. Authentication is limited to passwords as SSO is excluded, and auditability or privacy measures are omitted.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] "• We follow industry best practices for security."..."• Data is encrypted. ISO 27001 certification is planned for 2027."..."• Password login; SSO is available on the enterprise tier (not included in this price)."

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.justification: The support offering is limited to best-effort email with no uptime SLAs or phone support included. The vendor has only existed since 2024, lacks experience with large retailers, and does not provide active references directly in the response.
criteria.evidence: [Page 2] "Support: Email support during business hours (US Eastern time), best-effort response."..."Phone support, named account management and uptime SLAs are only available on the enterprise tier, which is not part of this offer."..."Relevant experience: BrightPath Tech was founded in 2024. We have completed two dashboard projects for small e-commerce companies, each with fewer than 200 suppliers and a single business unit. We have not yet delivered for a retailer of Northwind's size"..."References available on request."

suppliers.tie_break_note: Ranked above Scanned Supplier (error case): higher PPI (40.25 vs 0.00).
risks: Manual data pipeline risk: Platform relies on manual weekly CSV uploads prepared by Northwind because the SAP connector is unbuilt.
Scalability and performance risk: Deployment is restricted to a single cloud region and performance testing at Northwind's scale has not been performed.
Delivery risk: No risk management plan is provided, and project management is staffed only part-time.
Information security risk: Vendor currently lacks ISO 27001 certification (targeted for 2027) and excludes SSO from the proposed tier.
Experience risk: BrightPath Tech has only been in business since 2024 and has never deployed for an enterprise of Northwind's size.
Operational support risk: No uptime SLAs, phone support, or dedicated account management are included in the offered package.
suppliers.overall_summary: BrightPath Tech presents a low-cost, 12-week deployment proposal totaling $370,000, but fails to meet enterprise standards across technical architecture, security, support, and track record. Major deficiencies include reliance on manual CSV exports without a live SAP connector, unverified platform scalability, missing risk management, lack of ISO 27001 certification, best-effort support without SLAs, and no previous enterprise-scale delivery experience.
